hook: State-dependent diffusion makes equilibrium particles look like they sediment, repel or rotate.
hook_turn: look like they sediment, repel or rotate.
summary: When diffusion varies with a system's state, the drift measured from trajectories includes a spurious part unrelated to forces. It is identical forward and backward in time, so pairing it with the wrong diffusion tensor makes passive particles look active. The author shows how to infer this part from trajectory moments. The argument is theoretical in the abstract, without an experimental test.
title: And yet it moves - or does it? Spurious drifts at equilibrium
